changes: No substantive changes. Notes expanded to cover the unclear 'rṣa la yā m', the possible second date notation 'māse 1 tithau 7', and why 'suvedī' is treated as a surname or caste name.

date.as_written: śrīśāke 1775 māse 1 tithau 7 vaiśākha śu 3 vāre 4

notes: The date has two parts. 'māse 1 tithau 7' may be a separate solar-month and day notation, or a garbled reading. It sits beside the lunar date Vaiśākha śukla 3, Wednesday (vāre 4). ŚS 1775 + 78 gives about April–May 1853 CE, which matches the catalogue. The string 'rṣa la yā m' before the date is unclear; it may be corrupt, and no person can be read from it. 'Suvedī' (Subedī) is a Nepali Brahmin surname, so it goes under titles. 'śumbh' should be read as śubham. Vyāsa(muni), named as the speaker of the text, is a legendary sage and is left out.
